product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Anne Farmhouse French Wood Desk, 62"W, Blue
product.description: Bring a breezy French cottage look to your office with this desk. The washed navy finish gives it a vintage look, while the three drawers provide room for a tablet computer, pens and paper. Antiqued brass knobs add the perfect finishing touch. 28"L x 62"W x 30"H Solid poplar and engineered hardwoods; metal knobs with antique finish A French country look that will add a nice vibe to your traditional or farmhouse décor The interior of each drawer has velvet-lined bottom Assembly in an hour or less; just screw legs to base Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
